en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villa on a terraced hillside, surrounded by lush gardens and woodland. A forest of tall conifer trees rises steeply behind the building. In the foreground are pathways, stairways climbing the hill, small trees, fences, benches, and a gazebo-like pavilion. The house has several balconies and ornate window details typical of Central European spa or resort architecture. Text is faintly visible on the facade of the house.
